reuse.why: The actions reuse category eligibility, amount conversion and mutation helpers, but setZero copies the category query and isFixedGroup bypasses existing tag extraction.

duplication.why: setZero duplicates getAverageFillCategories' query, and isFixedGroup introduces another implementation of notes tag recognition.

placement.why: Budget policy and handler registration remain in their established layers, although tag parsing belongs with the existing shared tag utilities.

scope.why: The edits are confined to the requested budget actions, supporting data types, registration, tests and release notes.

maintainability.why: Eligibility remains centralized, but duplicated category loading and independent tag semantics create avoidable maintenance points.

bypasses_abstraction.where: actions.ts: setZero duplicates the loading available through getAverageFillCategories, and isFixedGroup uses a custom regex instead of shared/tags.ts tag extraction.

disguised_duplication.where: actions.ts: isFixedGroup reshapes the tag-recognition responsibility already implemented by extractTagsFromText into a dedicated regex.

abstraction_drift.where: getAverageFillCategories adds includeHiddenCategories, while shouldFillCategory replaces its existing hidden-policy parameter; all month-wide actions retain the shared eligibility decision, with no caller-specific exceptions.
